SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Ivo","3":"Hana","4":"Gus","5":"Ben","6":"Ann","7":"Cara","8":"Elif","9":"Dev"}

Ben must come after Finn, Hana, Ivo and Gus, so he is at slot 5 or later. Ann is directly after him, and Cara is after Ann. "Exactly one person between Ann and Elif" plus "Elif is immediately after Cara" forces Ann = Ben+1, Cara = Ben+2, Elif = Ben+3. Elif must come before Dev, and Dev is at most slot 9, so Ben is at most 5. That leaves Ben in slot 5, which fixes Ann at 6, Cara at 7, Elif at 8, and Dev at 9.

The remaining four slots hold Finn, Ivo, Hana and Gus. Ann–Hana at least 3 apart means Hana is at slot 3 or earlier. Finn and Gus at least 3 apart, with Finn before Hana, leaves Finn at 1 and Gus at 4. Hana is then at 3 and Ivo at 2, which satisfies Ivo before Gus and Hana = Ivo + 1.

I checked all 17 constraints against this arrangement and they hold. The schedule is the only one that works.

The team note is wrong on both alternatives. Ben can't be in slot 4, because Finn, Hana, Ivo and Gus all have to be before him. Dev can't be in slot 2, because Elif must be before Dev and Elif is forced to slot 8.

CONFIDENCE: 97
